name: molio-kb
description: Read-only access to your Molio local knowledge base: search, read, browse, and AI Q&A.
long_description:
Molio is a local-first knowledge base app. This bundle exposes 7 strictly read-only tools over your vaults: full-text search, file reading with encoding/binary handling, tree browsing, vault listing, and grounded AI Q&A (async start/poll).

Requires the Molio desktop app (or a Docker deployment of the Molio daemon) running on the same machine. Nothing is ever written back to your notes.

molio_port.title: Molio daemon port
molio_port.description: Port of the local Molio daemon HTTP API.

daemon_url.title: Daemon URL
daemon_url.description: Optional explicit daemon base URL (e.g. a NAS deployment). Leave empty to use http://127.0.0.1:<port>.
